ridge.cv: 9-fold grouped by item (item sites) / by answer item (answer position; E(a), E(b): by a, b), fixed permutation seed 0; fitted on all rows, scored per subset from the per-row OOF predictions
ridge.alpha: r * mean(S^2) of the centred training states; r chosen by inner 8-fold grouped CV on the training items only, grid 10^linspace(-5, 2, 15)
ridge.frozen: the 7323 fold fits (alpha chosen at 7323) applied to the same held-out rows of the later checkpoints, no refit
ridge.transport: residual R2 = 1 - SSE(Ec_hat) / SS(E(c) - (Ea_hat +- Eb_hat)), per op, per subset
